name: Iron Cross
instructions: Perform the movement with control through a full range of motion.
Repeat for the prescribed number of reps, resting as needed between sets.
longevityNotes: Pressing keeps shoulders useful, but joint-friendly volume beats grinding maxes. Full range, controlled tempo, and balanced pulling keep the shoulders healthy for decades.
overview: Iron Cross is an intermediate pushing exercise for the front delts, performed with dumbbells. Pressing strength keeps daily pushing tasks — and your shoulders — working well for decades.
